This guide is designed to be read in order the first time. Each section assumes knowledge from the previous ones.

## Fundamentals

The minimum that every team member needs to understand, regardless of their role.

- [Basic Concepts](01-conceptos.qmd) — What is Git, what is GitHub, and why they're not the same thing.
- [Initial Setup](02-setup.qmd) — Installing Git, terminal setup, and authentication with GitHub CLI.
- [Cloning Repositories](03-clonar.qmd) — How to download repositories using HTTPS or SSH.
